Class ReceiverTck

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.ReceiverTck
public abstract class ReceiverTck extends AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
Calls through a receiver: type variable, raw, parameterized, intersection and interface receivers, and the class scope in which a callee's type variables and inherited members are resolved.

A backend runs these tests by extending this class and implementing AbstractByteCodeWriterTck.write(io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ObjectDef).

Since:
2.3

    • overloadArgumentsRetainTheirLexicalBounds

      @ParameterizedTest(name="an argument of a {0} variable written {1} keeps its bound for overload selection") @CsvSource({"class, named","class, inline","method, named","method, inline"}) public void overloadArgumentsRetainTheirLexicalBounds(String scope, String declaration) throws Exception
      Overload lookup must interpret name-only variables in the enclosing declaration.
      Parameters:
      scope - Whether the argument's variable is declared by the class or by the method
      declaration - How the argument's type variable is written: by name or inline with its bound
      Throws:
      Exception - If the generated program cannot be loaded or invoked

    • externalBoundChainsRemainInTheCalleeScope

      @ParameterizedTest(name="a {0} chain of {1} bounds stays in the callee's scope") @CsvSource({"class, 2","class, 5","class, 10","class, 20","method, 2","method, 5","method, 10","method, 20"}) public void externalBoundChainsRemainInTheCalleeScope(String scope, int length) throws Exception
      Long bound chains are also exercised when passing an external generated method's arguments.
      Parameters:
      scope - Whether the chain is declared by the callee's class or by its method
      length - The number of variables in the chain
      Throws:
      Exception - If the generated program cannot be loaded or invoked

      @ParameterizedTest(name="a constructor argument of a {0} variable written {1} chooses javac's constructor") @CsvSource({"class, named","class, inline","method, named","method, inline"}) public void constructorsResolveLexicalTypeVariables(String scope, String declaration) throws Exception
      A constructor argument typed by a type variable resolves the constructor with the bound the variable has where it is declared.
